_comment: Inventory of rotatable secrets, grouped by cadence. Consumed by .github/workflows/secrets-rotation.yml, which opens a checklist issue when a cadence is due. Each secret lives encrypted in the referenced apps/<app>/.env.sops. Edit this file when secrets are added or removed; the values themselves never appear here.

quarterly.what: Cloudflare DNS API token (edits DNS + ACME challenge)
quarterly.where: Cloudflare dashboard → My Profile → API Tokens

quarterly.what: docker-cd /api/sync webhook secret (also GH Actions DOCKER_CD_API_SECRET)
quarterly.where: Regenerate random; update repo Actions secret too
Regenerate random; update Mend webhook config

quarterly.what: Garage S3 access key for linx bucket

quarterly.where: Twilio console → Account → API keys & tokens
Azure portal → resource → Keys and Endpoint

semiannual.what: Google OAuth client secret (gates all admin/media apps)
semiannual.where: Google Cloud console → Credentials → OAuth client
GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → OAuth Apps
GitHub → App settings → Private keys (generate new, delete old)

semiannual.what: Read API keys for arr/qbit/unifi/etc. dashboard widgets
semiannual.where: Each source app's settings → API key (rotate as a batch)

annual.what: Master backup key. Rotating orphans ALL existing restic snapshots — do NOT rotate casually. Confirm it is still stored in your password manager.
annual.where: Only rotate with a full re-backup plan; see docs/disaster-recovery.md

annual.what: SOPS master key. Rotating requires re-encrypting all .env.sops files. Confirm offline copies exist.
annual.where: Only rotate deliberately; re-run sops updatekeys across all files

annual.what: SESSION_SECRET / JWT_SECRET / cookie secrets / salts across bang, calendar, close-powerlifting, gains, mm2us, notify, convertx, umami, gitea
annual.where: openssl rand -hex 32 per secret; users re-login after change

annual.what: POSTGRES_PASSWORD / DB_PASSWORD for hello-world, immich, miniflux, umami
annual.where: Rotate in .env.sops AND ALTER USER in the DB, or dump→recreate→restore

annual.what: vaultwarden ADMIN_TOKEN, dbgate PASSWORD, calendar/screenshot APP_PASSWORD, miniflux ADMIN_PASSWORD, cap ADMIN_KEY, beszel KEY/TOKEN
annual.where: Regenerate per app; vaultwarden token via 'docker exec vaultwarden /vaultwarden hash'

annual.what: EMAIL_PASSWORD / EMAIL_AUTH_PASS / SMTP_PASSWORD for bang, close-powerlifting, gains, notify, vaultwarden
